name: libvips
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
summary: Demand-driven, multi-threaded image processing library with a vips command line and bindings for C, Python and others. Streams large images at low memory and is the engine under sharp. Distinguishing strength: speed and memory on big batches without a Node runtime.
use_when: Over ImageMagick for very large images or fast batch resize at low memory
Shell or Python pipelines without a Node runtime
Tiling and pyramids (dzsave) for big stills
avoid_when: Node pipelines: sharp wraps libvips with a friendlier API
Broad effects and format coverage: imagemagick

assessment.rationale: Maintained (Homebrew stable 8.18.7). The vips CLI streams huge images at low memory, but sharp wraps the same library for Node and ImageMagick covers the broad CLI case. Keep as candidate for standalone CLI use.
